gate.label: Canonical parcellation
gate.blocker: Canonical Schaefer/Yeo extraction and ranking are available.

canonical_parcellation.engineering_logic: Use Schaefer parcels as state nodes and Yeo networks as interpretable macro-supernodes; then test whether mechanism rankings survive the refined state-space.
canonical_parcellation.claim_guardrail: The 8-module Harvard-Oxford mapping remains a transparent proxy until Schaefer/Yeo extraction is run.

external ds006072 run without score retuning
rocket_strengthening.claim_guardrail: ROCKET remains supporting internal proxy evidence until null, calibration, and external gates pass.

gate.label: External validation
gate.blocker: Drug-order mapping and unchanged scoring are locked, but local ds006072 CIFTI/module time-series payloads are absent. Download or provide authorized processed rest CIFTIs before claiming validation.

external_validation.recommended_external_dataset: OpenNeuro ds006072 psilocybin precision functional mapping
external_validation.fixed_rule: Run the same LSD scoring rules on psilocybin/control data without retuning after seeing results.
external_validation.claim_guardrail: Metadata and manifests are not external validation; comparable empirical target extraction is required.

receptor_structural.claim_guardrail: E is proxy-only until structural and receptor priors are both implemented with null controls.
